title: PartnerSubscriptionTokenRequest
description: PartnerSubscriptionTokenRequest represents the request's body for subscription token API

components.description: Components is a list of components to add on to the plan

coupon_code.description: CouponCode is the coupon code to be attached to the activation

price_handle.description: ProductPricePointHandle is the product price point handle

return_url.description: ReturnURL is the URL to which the user is redirected to after giving his/her consent

PartnerSubscriptionTokenComponent.description: PartnerSubscriptionTokenComponent represents a component to be added to a subscription

component_handle.description: Unique reference to the component to be included in the new subscription

component_price_handle.description: Unique reference to the component price point

quantity.description: How many components should be added
